test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six colleagues X, Y, Z, A, B, and C are sitting in a row facing south. Z is to the immediate right of C who is sitting at one of the ends. A sits third to the right of B. X does not sit adjacent to B. Who sits to the immediate left of A?
solution:
Given: Six colleagues X, Y, Z, A, B, and C are sitting in a row facing south.

1) Z is to the immediate right of C who is sitting at one of the ends.

2) A sits third to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d7a027315c450c62e6f311d266eacf6cfa5917830d49a2a935feb9e9e09d94e.png] 

3) X does not sit adjacent to B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/287cb1ff2e8f3807c929bc302b821f9afc39742740ec85974e3b2533e9d3ae06.png] 

Here, "X" sits to the immediate left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
